passages.note: Mesnard is listed as prime sponsor of SB 1828 (2021), an Arizona tax-code bill; signed into law 06/30/2021.
Mesnard voted Yea on Senate Third Reading of SB 1828, which passed 16-14.

passages.provision_quote: for taxable years beginning from and after December 31 of the year in which notice is provided to the department pursuant to section 43-243, subsection B, paragraph 2, the tax is 2.5% of taxable income.
passages.note: Sec. 15 (A.R.S. 43-1011) phases the individual income tax from graduated brackets topping out at 4.50% down to a flat 2.5% rate.

rows.reasoning: As prime sponsor of SB 1828 (2021) and with a Yea vote on its Third Reading (16-14), Mesnard enacted Sec. 15 (A.R.S. 43-1011), which phases Arizona's individual income tax from graduated brackets topping out at 4.50% down to a flat 2.5% rate for all filers, a broad cut to the main income tax rate most people pay, matching rung 4's text 'Cut taxes broadly, including the main rates most people pay.' The act includes no spending or government-scope reduction, so rung 5's second clause is not evidenced.
